termsBody:
உதவு (Uthavu) is a community help network for Tamil Nadu — it connects people who need help with nearby volunteers, in real time.

By using Uthavu you agree to: post help requests honestly, respond to requests you can genuinely help with, and treat other members with respect. Uthavu never charges you and no money ever changes hands between users through the app — sponsors and ads are the only revenue, and neither ever touches your reports or missions.

You're responsible for the accuracy of what you post. Reports that turn out to be false, abusive, or spam can be removed, and repeated misuse can lead to your account being suspended.

Uthavu is built and run by a small team, not a large company. These terms may change as the product grows — we'll keep this page up to date when they do.
privacyBody:
We collect only what Uthavu actually needs to work: your phone number (to sign you in via OTP), your name and an optional profile photo, your location (to show you nearby help requests and let others find yours), and the reports and messages you create.

Email is never required anywhere in the app — it's an optional, private profile field only used for future account recovery, and never shown to other users.

Your phone number is only ever shown to another user if you explicitly choose to share it on a specific report. You can also post a report anonymously, hiding your name from everyone except the volunteers who join to help.

We don't sell your data, and we don't run a rating or scoring system on you — trust on Uthavu comes from verification and your real completion history, not a public score.

You can delete your account at any time from Settings — this permanently removes your reports, missions, messages, and profile data.
guidelinesBody:
Uthavu exists so real help reaches real people quickly. A few simple rules keep that working:

• Post only genuine requests for help — animal rescue, medical help, food donation, roadside help, elderly support, blood donation, community help, or lost & found.
• Don't post spam, advertising, or requests unrelated to getting or giving help.
• Be honest in comments and messages — false or misleading information can put someone's safety at risk.
• Respect other members' privacy — don't share someone else's phone number or personal details without their consent.
• If a comment looks like spam, abuse, or false information, flag it — our team reviews every flagged comment.

We don't use star ratings on Uthavu. A volunteer's trustworthiness is built from real, verified completion history — not a number anyone can be unfairly judged by.
